title: Test message construction: missing C_R identifier in message_2
description:
Root Cause: Two tests construct message_2 incorrectly - they put all bytes inside the byte string with nothing left for C_R (connection identifier). The message_2 structure requires G_Y||CIPHERTEXT_2 as a byte string FOLLOWED BY C_R as a separate CBOR element. When begin_process_message_2 calls parse_identifier(&msg2[consumed..]) on the empty remainder, it returns Err(EdhocError::InvalidMessage) because the slice is empty, returning early BEFORE DH computation and BEFORE poison() is called.

Affected Tests:
1. initiator_post_dh_failure_wipes_and_poison_state (lines 777-780)
   - msg2 = [0x58,33] + [7;32] + [0] (35 bytes total)
   - Should be: [0x58,33] + [7;32] + [0] + [0x01] (36 bytes with C_R=1)

2. rejects_all_zero_x25519_shared_secret (lines 806-808)
   - Same issue - missing C_R after the byte string

Location: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/tests.rs

Suggested Fix: Add C_R identifier after the byte string in both tests. Change msg2 construction to append [0x01] (C_R=1 as CBOR int) after the bstr. Example: msg2 = [0x58,33] + [7;32] + [0] + [0x01] (36 bytes total).

Error Type: Test Vector Construction Error
